shorts_extract.hook: 2,300 fake words, one ticking metronome, and a 56% first-hour cliff: how Hermann Ebbinghaus turned human forgetting — and spaced review — into exact math.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Ebbinghaus (1885) Savings curve (58.2% at 20m to 44.2% at 1h to 33.7% at 1d to 21.1% at 31d) + Murre & Dros (2015) replication.
shorts_extract.twist: Why 'I remember zero' hides massive subconscious Savings, why overnight sleep paused the 9h-to-24h drop, and why meaningful poetry cuts effort 10x.
